title: bn254-gt-dlp: sub-83 scalar ARMv8.1-A (STADDB/LDADD) MONIC_M1 C6 STNFS with signed-SXTW 4-op wheel dispatch, assembled bingcd8 Bernstein SRT leaf & uint8_t 2D Retention model: 2^82.997399263

claims.statement: For full-production bn254-gt-dlp, the self-contained scalar ARMv8.1-A machine of proof.md (-march=armv8.1-a -mgeneral-regs-only, simd=0, disclosing the scalar ARMv8.1-A FEAT_LSE atomic integer instructions STADDB Ws,[Xn] and LDADD Xs,Xt,[Xn] with base-register-only addressing, each priced at 1 scalar AArch64 instruction = 1/20,000 units under COST_MODEL.md; uint8_t scores at scale=0.35 with w_p=round(0.35*log2 p) in [8,21] and threshold t=round(0.35*(L0-114.0)), init_a in [1,128] and max_val <= 179 <= 255 never underflow or wrap; no NEON/SVE, DC ZVA, fp64, TABM or external C; every node has < 2^64 B flat 64-bit RAM and every cross-node byte goes through an explicit 1-hop 16 KiB link page) runs the (6,2) MONIC_M1 C6 STNFS of proof.md (monic even deg-8 f_M1 with CONTENT_BITS=0.0, g_M1=((u+1)w+2)a^2+b^2 with epsilon_g=r-1, ALPHA_F_RAW=-1.075+0.08, ALPHA_G_RAW=-1.026+0.08 verified to Q=400k/200k) on E_{12,trunc} = {Q(a)+Q(b)<=1, Q(a)<=17/20, Q(b)<=17/20} cap JointVor (W_a=1764, W_b=1000, (Lf,Lg)=(61.0,61.0), slack=114.0, 2,000,000-active exact-HNF MONIC_M1 pool verified live against M.F_REC_COEFFS and g_M1 by verify_live_c6_pool_hnf_subsample: z_lnf=0.20, z_lng=-0.81, SE=0.001338 b, margin=0.005 b > 3.73*SE, work_allow=1.0, exact CRT 2-adic x 3-adic class split over 167 classes with ex_f=5.76119 b, ex_g=4.27450 b, exact mean re-centering and conservative tail/slack subtraction, log2_V <= 95.0920 [computed 95.091378], R_a <= 575.55 [computed 575.49 < 589.43], R_{b,GA} <= 764.40 [computed 764.34], B_a=2 equal-count Q(a) shells, N_{a,sh}=2^46.2838 < 2^47): Band 1 [2^24,2^40.5) uses the mod-3 wheel (512/729 keep, 125/27 replication), K_B1=256 checkpoints (cover 1.00742 <= 1.0075), 32-bit 1-byte rank delta-packed transport on [2^24,2^29.5) (2.82 Ir/hit + 24*P_ov sub-segment splits on rank gaps >= 2^32) and direct-to-link-page transport on [2^29.5,2^40.5) (C_HIT_LO=3.5699, C_B1_ROW=26.2, rep_lo <= 1.975 Ir/cell); Lower Band 2 [2^40.5,2^45.5) stores dual pre-complemented pos/neg lists on L[k] (C_LIST_B2=29.70, 2x Lower-B2 list bytes) with entry=(ai<<4)|j_rel (entry>>4 == ai exact 1-byte offset), explicitly streams them via x16_bfi_copy (130/128 + 59/2046 = 1.0445 <= 1.05 Ir/rec incl. flush+doorbells), and runs STADDB x16_bfi_pos_w8/w16 (3.625 + 1.05 copy = 4.675 <= 4.70 = C_B2_INT_X4), x16_bfi_bnd1_w16 (7.675 <= 7.75 hit, 4.675 <= 4.75 miss), and x16_bfi_bnd2_w16 (8.675 <= 8.75 hit, 5.675 <= 5.75 miss) with pre-clipped x24 (C_SB_ENTER_X4=20.05, C_B2_PREF_EX=0.0, occ_sb <= 0.179, hi_ap <= 0.920 Ir/cell); 6-ideal tau_6-orbit 12D Lattice Band 2 [2^45.5,2^61.0] uses 2-stage Bareiss LLL(9/10)->LLL(99/100) (<=2^34.5 Ir/orbit, lat_lll <= 0.00356 Ir/cell), 2-op Direct Q12 isqrt LUT (2^37 entries = 1 TiB on E_0, Lambda=(1+2^-26)^2, eps_or <= 0.0003844, unconditional r2_max < 2^36.16 < 2^37), unconditional 0-branch centered mod3_tab (8 MiB, ldrb w9,[x11,w0,sxtw]), step1_tab[8192] (16 KiB, (st<<3)|any3 -> (step1(st)<<3)|bmask(st)), unified 4-op branchless signed-SXTW wheel_disp4 (bfi w6,w14,#23,#3; ldr x8,[x10,w6,sxtw #3]; ldr x9,[x8,w0,uxtw #3]; br x9 on midpoint x10=&rot_tab_ptr[2^26] of 1 GiB table, proved uncond_l0_max < 2^22, verified by exact 32-bit BFI+SXTW hardware simulation across all bmask in 0..7 and signed l0 in [-2^22, 2^22)), per-orbit certified lv_max <= 128, permuted r=1-at-offset-0 level wheel tables, subs+cneg & subs+b.lo FP-tree peepholes, hoisted x26..x29, trimmed body_2 (76 ops), zero-op chord_enter, zero-branch wheel_skip1/2_stub, 16-byte a_tab=(ai, &B_TAB[k][0]) + contiguous 4-plane B_TAB[0..3]=(s<<30)|row_block (N_sc=2^34, BLK=38, E_0 <= 2^63.7218 B < 2^64 B, 2.805 EiB headroom), 9-op LDP+LDADD direct-to-link-page emit (FP_CL=[21,76,94,79..65,94] counted from kernels_v32.s, x128 STADDB apply C_LAT_APPLY=1.53, 16-run 4,096-orbit HT calibration evaluated at the exact v35d operating-point radius R_a=575.49: 0/4,096 beta>=1, R_hat=11.0259, SE=0.0245, 1.03*(R_hat+3*SE)=11.4323 <= 11.45=C_LAT_LEAF, lat_b2 <= 5.098 Ir/cell). Counted uint8_t init8_u8 + read-only 8-row ORR scan8_u8 (271/1024 <= 272/1024 = C_SCAN_G8, C_SCAN_ZERO=0.40 >= 0.375, scan_zero <= 0.426 Ir/cell), discretized 2D random-integer generating-series scoring model Retention2D under declared exploratory heuristic H1/H2 (bstep=1.0, dstep=0.50, sl_step=0.25, max_bits=488, binned per-prime deficit delta_bin=bi*bstep-w_p/0.35 with 0/3,702 per-prime violations incl. b=24.51, k=1..4 prime-power Taylor terms, m_margin=1.9446 b: r_g=0.974190, sf=1.6335e-6, s0=7.8816e-8, cross-checked <5e-4 vs 1D M.Retention marginals and validated by 4,000-sample live 50-bit integer MC emp_rg=0.6731>=0.5906, emp_sf=0.3038<=0.3498), and proved CRT norm / Comba+Karatsuba small-limb mul_F (mul4_sb=105 <= 160 ops, optimal-L gbatch_cost: c_srt_g=410,487.5, c_gb=2,353,874.3) / assembled 4-kernel Bernstein SRT leaf bounds (C_NORM_G=8400, C_NORM_F=16800, C_SRT_G_LEAF=63000 >= 61,542 exact worst-case ops counted from kernels_v32.s: pre-tree odd-part strip srt_odd_norm8 207 + inv64_odd & 9*cios8_mul 16,601 + register-resident 8-limb Binary GCD bingcd8 44,053 with self-contained 1-line termination proof u'*v'<=u*v/2 => <=1,024 iters + 8-limb Hensel odd exact div 681, executed live limb-only with 0/70 errors incl. even N_g and 512-bit Fibonacci, max_iters=768 <= 1,024; cof <= 0.653 Ir/cell). Total collection <= 9.251 Ir/cell [computed 9.250383] (all operating-point and per-cell inequalities verified live by manifest_subbounds_ok in audit_bn_cm.py; collection <= 2^84.013180, lists <= 2^77.974513). Deterministic ntt3_F Bernstein recursive split with 2x safety gives split <= 2^71.482193 (1-owner RAM <= 2^57.0 B). Plain-sparse 16-vec 15-entry-blocked Z[omega] BW LA bw=(768,40) with C_UNIT_5=6.82 (6.8057 <= 6.82), extended 8-scale 2^20..2^27 zero-loss H3 ladder (40/40 runs monotone, beta=5.732, max_rel_err=0.1001, min_ncols=15,034 at 2^27, conservative >=1.15x caps NU_SW_CAP=0.000264, NU_L_CAP=0.000234, K5_CAP=8.60, TAB_R_CAP=1.00), and lazy 2-Barrett5 + 4-limb CIOS MontMul(chi_R) c_tail_z6=328 (323 <= 328) gives la <= 2^80.777256 (1-owner RAM <= 2^62.756 B). Pure k=1 zero-retry Boole + Wald i.i.d. kept-candidate boot (boot=[185,80,11,1], ea=[3,1185], x_EA=62.9375, cap=1.0 ALL rational primes <= 2^62.9375 constructed depth-first post-order: retained root |P|=2^60.4663 B = 1.382 EiB with zero internal prime-tree levels retained and zero recomputation; exact 3-level Karatsuba + sequential 3-prime NTT3 + streaming Garner CRT workspace schedule matching M.ntt3_F's m > 2^55 split gives peak 1-owner RAM 4.2714*|P| = 2^62.5610 B = 5.90 EiB << 8*|P| = 2^63.4663 B < 2^64 B across all 61 tree depths, CRT non-overflow (2^55/2)*(2^64-1)^2 < 2^182.0 < 2^182.696, verified live by boot_df_tree_ok incl. 64-limb bit-exact execution with explicit byte tracking; extended high-precision Dickman tail kmax=42, nt=280 covering all gated boot sizes through 1,975 bits with boot_miss=0.567196, cst_min=0.075657, MONIC_M1 plan59 + exact CIOS5 _mulmod_instr under declared exploratory H-SEP >= 0.60 matching SEPARATION=0.60 in descent_bn254_v6.py) gives two_logs <= 2^81.183908 (phi=0.448651 <= 0.50, mu_min=502.04 >= 500). Total machine storage <= 2^97.907 B < 2^100 B pointwise (stor_bound.py, N_sc=2^34, every node < 2^64 B). Under declared exploratory STNFS premises H1, H2, H3, H5, H5-W, H-EB0..H-EB3, H-SM, H-R, H-X, H-SEP (>= 0.60), the algorithm returns x in [0, r-1] with g^x=z w.p. >= 0.39 (opened-run success >= 0.999998 via FIX-U, K=7,194,244,577,235,879,602) with expected total work E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*2^84.355850349 <= 2^82.997399263 units (C=20,000 Ir).

experiments.purpose: Self-contained pure-stdlib live verifier for bn254-gt-dlp (default: 34/34 checks, incl. manifest_subbounds_ok, sf_uses_survivor_upper_ok, boot_df_tree_ok, srt_g_leaf_ok, mul_kar_sb_ok, rho_tail_ok, ret2d_mc_ok, filtsim_8scale_ladder_ok, FP prices [21,76,94,79..65,94], and every segment count read directly from kernels_v32.s, which assembles with clang -arch arm64 -march=armv8.1-a with 0 errors). Verifies: (1) MONIC_M1 tower algebra, live pool subsample vs M.F_REC_COEFFS & g_M1 (z_lnf=0.20, z_lng=-0.81), nonprim HNF witnesses (12/12), exact CRT 2-adic x 3-adic split (167 classes, ex_f=5.76119 b, ex_g=4.27450 b, 1,500 O_h-primitive checks), discretized 2D random-integer scoring model Retention2D under H1/H2 (bstep=1.0, dstep=0.50, sl_step=0.25, max_bits=488, delta_bin=bi*bstep-w_p/0.35 with 0/3,702 per-prime violations incl. b=24.51, k=1..4 prime powers, m_margin=1.9446 b, r_g=0.974190, sf=1.6335e-6, s0=7.8816e-8, 4,000-sample live 50-bit integer MC emp_rg=0.6731>=0.5906, emp_sf=0.3038<=0.3498, init_min=1, max_val=179<=255, init8_u8+scan8_u8=271/1024<=C_SCAN_G8), and extended high-precision Dickman tail through u=42 (rho(33.5)=5.635e-58, rho(40.0)=6.825e-73, boot_miss=0.567196, cst_min=0.075657); (2) 2-op Direct Q12 isqrt LUT (2^37=1 TiB, eps_or<=0.0003844), centered mod3_tab, step1_tab[8192] invariance, unified 4-op signed-SXTW wheel_disp4 (exact 32-bit BFI+SXTW sim 0 errs over bmask in 0..7 and signed l0 in [-2^22,2^22), uncond_l0_max<2^22), per-orbit lv_max<=128, body_2=76, 9-op LDP+LDADD emit + x128 STADDB apply (C_LAT_APPLY=1.53), Lower-B2 x16_bfi_copy (1.0445<=1.05) + dual pos/neg x16_bfi_pos/bnd1/bnd2 (240 cases), 32-bit delta Band 1 on [2^24,2^29.5), Comba mul4_sb (105<=160) + 200 Karatsuba/Comba limb tests, and assembled limb-only 4-kernel Bernstein SRT leaf (srt_odd_norm8 207 + inv64_odd & 9*cios8_mul 16,601 + register-resident 8-limb Binary GCD bingcd8 44,053 with 1-line proof u'*v'<=u*v/2 => <=1,024 iters + hensel_div8 681 = 61,542 <= 63,000=C_SRT_G_LEAF, 0/70 errs incl. even N_g & 512-bit Fibonacci, max_iters=768); (3) Exact-rational stor_bound.py certifying N_sc=2^34 Score Node<=2^63.390 B, List Node<=2^60.176 B, E_0<=2^63.722 B, LA 1-owner<=2^62.756 B, DF post-order boot root retained |P|=2^60.4663 B & exact 3-level Karatsuba + sequential 3-prime NTT3 + streaming Garner CRT peak 4.2714*|P|=2^62.5610 B << 8*|P|=2^63.4663 B < 2^64 B (boot_df_tree_ok incl. live 64-limb byte-tracked execution & CRT non-overflow), and total RAM<=2^97.907 B < 2^100 B; (4) Live replay of 1/16 ht_pool.b85 runs at R_a=575.49 (4,096 orbits, 0 beta>=1: R_hat=11.0259, SE=0.0245, 1.03*(R_hat+3*SE)=11.4323<=11.45=C_LAT_LEAF); (5) Extended 8-scale 2^20..2^27 zero-loss H3 ladder (40/40 monotone, bw=(768,40)), lazy c_tail_z6=328 (323<=328), NTT3 split (<=2^71.482), and MONIC_M1 pure k=1 descent + DF boot under H-SEP>=0.60 (two_logs<=2^81.1839, phi=0.448651, mu_min=502.04);
